searches.reason: Investigate replacing single-negative binary supervision with a ranking objective that improves discrimination among plausible alternatives. Electronics has 14.95% negative-over-positive errors, while the embedding diagnostics do not show severe collapse. Seek practical sampling methods with false-negative safeguards; compare using pinned macro validation HR@10 rather than training margins alone.

searches.reason: Explore an architecture that separates recent task intent from repeated long-term preferences and learns when each matters. This addresses loosely related recommendations and overemphasis on occasional historical interests. Seek lightweight approaches using observed histories and timestamps, without assuming ownership implies satisfaction or inferring unobserved user traits.

searches.reason: Investigate learning item representations jointly from interactions and available titles/descriptions, with text encoders trained from scratch. Content may help distinguish specific formats, equipment, and recurring themes that item IDs miss. Seek evidence-aware fusion that handles missing or ambiguous descriptions without inventing compatibility labels or requiring pretrained weights.
